quote_contract.database: Two additive quoted INSERT/UPDATE consistency guards, installed transactionally at initialization and required for ordinary quoted writes. No new table, column or delta schema. Prior quoted counter formula is checked before highwater.

limits: No monetary reservation or transactional dollar admission is implemented by this slice. Concurrent requests can still share the same dollar remainder. Token reservations remain separate.
Captured quotes are per-operation estimates, not provider invoices or conservative cost upper bounds. Provider fallback rates remain rough and not model-specific unless configured.
Rates and USD caps are not yet pinned for an entire run or child launch. Later operations may capture different ambient rates. Historical unpriced usage does not acquire known costs.
Only covered shared and native nonstreaming physical API boundaries produce quotes. Legacy/non-API estimation and old new-operation writers are not retroactively covered.

A malformed nonempty API price configuration now stops dispatch even with USDcap0; this is intentional strict validation. Empty configuration and valid default requests retain cost arithmetic and serialized wire behavior.
